clues.it: Carla era nella 10ª colonna e accanto a un serbatoio.
clues.en: Carla was in the 10th column and beside a fuel tank.

clues.it: Olga era nella 2ª riga, accanto a una consolle e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Olga was in the 2nd row, beside a console and north of Nino.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 4ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e a nord di Paolo.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 4th column, in the 3rd row and north of Paolo.

clues.it: Dario era nella 7ª colonna, nella 4ª riga, l'unico seduto su una sedia e in una stanza diversa da Paolo.
clues.en: Dario was in the 7th column, in the 4th row, the only one sitting on a chair and in a different room from Paolo.

clues.it: Giada era nella 5ª colonna e nella 5ª riga, ma non era accanto a un reattore.
clues.en: Giada was in the 5th column and in the 5th row, but was not beside a reactor.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 8ª colonna, nella 6ª riga e a ovest di Luca.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 8th column, in the 6th row and west of Luca.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 2ª colonna e accanto a un reattore, ma non era accanto a un'antenna.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 2nd column and beside a reactor, but was not beside an antenna.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Nino era nella 1ª colonna, nella 9ª riga e a ovest di Carla.
clues.en: Nino was in the 1st column, in the 9th row and west of Carla.

clues.it: Luca non era accanto a un serbatoio.
clues.en: Luca was not beside a fuel tank.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Carla lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Carla's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 10th.
